svg.title: GVL NK cell
svg.desc: Generic NK antileukemic cytotoxicity. Dashed contact denotes an unspecified net activating interaction, not proof that NKG2C/HLA-E causes GvL.

g.inkscape:label: NK cell – orange body, lectin receptors, no TCR
Recipient leukemic blast: large nucleus and HLA-I
HLA class I / HLA-E peptide complex
Heavy chain: stalk, single transmembrane helix and cytoplasmic tail
User free-form peptide in HLA groove
User free-form nine-residue core, native vectors
